articles.translatedExcerpt: A Perfect Circle released their new single "To Whom It May Concern" on Tuesday, September 29, 2026. This work explores the themes of division in modern society and anger and hatred amplified by algorithms. The song depicts the reality in which people who were once able to communicate have come to see each other as enemies. This song is a message to a specific person, but also a warning to people living in modern times. The deep and ominous sound and vocals highlight the tension of the song.
